$comment: Phase 2, slice 4: markets. A market stall lets the villages around it (within the scenario's market.reach, that have met the market's village) trade at supply-and-demand prices instead of fixed item values (src/sim/markets.js). Trade routes can only be researched in scenarios that turn markets on (a `market` block in the scenario), so classic scenarios never build one.

tech.name: Trade routes
tech.description: Regular routes between villages. Unlocks the market stall: villages in its reach trade at prices set by supply and demand.
